ab205_trial_limits: ABB AB205 nominal family dimensions are a conditional factory-angle input, not an accepted purchased part. Hole pitch, flange width and offsets lack product-specific tolerance and received-part confirmation.

Four nominal 9/16-inch bore cylinders pass through full raw CAD wood at this one pose. The rail bore crosses its 38.1-mm thickness; the bolt center lies 50.8 mm from the nearest edge of its broad face, exactly 4D with zero nominal margin. This conditional edge arithmetic is not a complete NDS joint classification or a tolerance allowance.
Frozen 66 panel/kicker and 12 frame-bolt occupied axes have no nominal bore-cylinder intersection. Their modeled diameters are analysis envelopes, not purchased hardware or drilling instructions.

The raw center-principal gap is 101.9 mm before opposing flanges and hardware. The other side of each 38.1-mm member needs opposing flange, washer, nut, socket, backing and withdrawal-path assessment. Adjacent new structural angles, tolerance stack and physical assembly were not checked.

AB205 has no established guaranteed steel strength or wood-joint rating. ABB's 2,000-lb strut-channel rating is inapplicable here; two-wood single-shear capacity is not an AB205 steel-to-wood capacity. Simultaneous joint actions remain unresolved.
load_path: Separate flange bolts cannot be counted as one shared physical bolt without a traced bearing/contact path; legacy SDS reactions are screening inputs only, not new reactions.
disposition: The actual-CAD AB205 pose has full nominal raw-wood bores and no nominal retained-axis intersection. The rail broad-face bolt center is exactly 4D from its nearest edge, with zero nominal margin. Opposing hardware access, complete stack, strength, and load path remain unresolved. No connector or drilling release.
